name: adversarial_selfconsistent_fee_lie
description: The 'smart lie.' LLM proposes actual_fee=119.80, which makes its own math perfect: gross(4823.00) - actual_fee(119.80) = 4703.20 = settled_amount. Guard rejects because 119.80 disagrees with the settlement row's actual fee_charged (96.46) by Rs.23.34, far outside the Rs.4.82 tolerance for a Rs.4823 gross. This is the pitch talking point: the guard validates against the settlement's own numbers, not against numbers the model produced. Anchored on ORD-0006 from the live batch.

llm_response.reasoning: The aggregator applied a custom higher fee of Rs.119.80 instead of the expected Rs.96.46. This reconciles: 4823.00 - 119.80 = 4703.20 = settled_amount.
